resolutionRules: Retained artifacts preserve authentic bytes, including original absolute/work citations. Resolve an absolute sourcePath or sourceRepoRelativePath using retainedArtifacts to its committedPath; preserve any citation line suffix.

A critic artifact reference relative to work/critic-run-1, ../work/critic-run-1, or a bare artifact suffix resolves under destinationEvidenceRoot by the same relative path. A bare basename resolves only if unique among retainedArtifacts.
Builder evidence references evidence/run-1/... or run-1 child folders remain under the task evidence directory and are pinned in existingCommittedEvidence; they were not duplicated.

Source references including Makefile, apps/, packages/, tools/, Dockerfile or ../Dockerfile resolve at baseCommit through sourceMappings and git show <commit>:<committedPath>. Source commit 49b has the same implementation bytes as codeCandidate.

Scratch repo node_modules and generated dist outputs are command execution inputs, not retained proof artifacts; reconstruct from the pinned source and lockfile if needed. They were deliberately not copied.
suiteDisposition: No product suite promotion: run 1 is refuted; this retention makes the complete critic report and cited review artifacts durable.
